**Kind:** `happy_path`
**Status:** `draft`

## SCN-012 — Export of a hand-edited projection is refused

**Kind:** `error_path`
**Status:** `draft`
**Anchor:** `docs/system/capabilities/doc-evolution#0-as-implemented-2026-09-15`

### Preconditions

A projection file was edited after the last export (`edited_in_place`).

### Steps

1. Call `doc_export` without force

### Expected result

`ExportGuardError` is raised; the hand edit is not overwritten.

TSC-002. Claims match code as of 2026-09-15.

## SCN-014 — SQLite document row is SoT; markdown is a projection

**Kind:** `invariant`
**Status:** `draft`
**Anchor:** `docs/system/capabilities/doc-evolution#0-as-implemented-2026-09-15`

### Preconditions

### Steps
